k5.privacy.closure_intro: Two people: one proposes (carry out or refuse, with the reason communicated to the organisation), another confirms. Execution removes access to the files (people keep their files), erases internal notes, notifications and member accounts, closes ongoing follow-ups and referrals, and cancels upcoming appointments while informing the people. An active legal hold on the organisation blocks it.

It publishes what it could confirm, updates what changed, withdraws what no longer exists, merges duplicates and adds new public services. <0>You have nothing to approve</0>: this page tells you what happened, with the evidence, and only alerts you about what matters.

k5.providers.title: Providers and integrations
k5.providers.intro: State computed only from the presence of the configuration variables: their values are never read or shown, and no provider is called. “Configured” does not mean “verified”: the real check is done with the script shown, at activation.
k5.security.title: Security signals
k5.security.intro: The health check (every 5 minutes) reads the audit log and sends an alert through the alert channel when a threshold is reached. Only numbers are shown here: no address, no e-mail.
